description: Defines RBAC (Role-Based Access Control) API types for Kubernetes, including roles, role bindings, cluster roles, and their lists, along with associated metadata and policy rules.

classes.name: PolicyRule
classes.description: Describes a policy rule with verbs, API groups, resources, resource names, and non-resource URLs.

classes.name: Subject
classes.description: References user, group, or service account identities for role bindings.

classes.name: RoleRef
classes.description: Points to the role being used in role bindings.

classes.name: Role
classes.description: A namespaced grouping of PolicyRules that can be referenced by a RoleBinding.

classes.name: RoleBinding
classes.description: References a role and specifies subjects and namespace.

classes.name: ClusterRole
classes.description: A cluster-wide grouping of PolicyRules, possibly with aggregation.

classes.name: AggregationRule
classes.description: Defines how to locate and aggregate ClusterRoles into a ClusterRole.

classes.name: ClusterRoleBinding
classes.description: References a ClusterRole and subjects, applicable at cluster scope.
